purpose: Engineering input-capacity probe for a possible future second task; no formal Hotpot scientific template, data split, candidate admission or inference.

sample.method: uniform without replacement on concatenated two-shard global row indices; sort selected indices for deterministic reading

serialization: Use existing collector_payload unchanged, preserving every context title/sentence in original order and compact JSON. Use Executor.question_payload and Executor._messages unchanged; payload means exact qtext (question + two newlines + Supplied context: newline + compact context JSON), without identity metadata.
models: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 local tokenizer with tokenizer.model supplement revision c170c708c41dac9275d15a8fff4eca08d52bab71
tokenizer_policy: CPU only, offline, no trust_remote_code, no weights or HFBackend construction. First attempt local AutoTokenizer fast backend from small copied tokenizer files only. Missing dependency is reported without environment upgrade; any fallback must be explicit and validated before claiming real template counts.

counting.worker_base: all four actual round-1 messages from existing executor, apply_chat_template(tokenize=True,add_generation_prompt=True)
counting.aggregate_placeholder: existing aggregate message builder with four empty-string wire messages; real chat-template tokenization of this artificial placeholder, not an actual generated aggregate input

reserve_warning: Reserve means assumed additional total tokens under the receiving tokenizer. Four sender-token caps are not a proven bound after JSON escaping or cross-tokenizer conversion. No actual later-round messages are generated.
metrics: min,median,p90,p95,p99,max payload and base prompt tokens
counts over 8192 and counts over 8192 after each hypothetical reserve
wall and CPU time for input reading and tokenization
interpretation: Sample maxima cover only the fixed 2000 rows, not all train. Fit does not establish GPU memory/time feasibility, answer quality, supporting-fact quality or successful full graph execution.
